answer: Each agent must fill and keep a unique data vault keyed to its own public key, proven by random storage audits every epoch. One honest agent carves this storage canyon a single time; a sybil operator has to dig a fresh canyon for every fake key, so the cost rises linearly with clone count and no ripple of shared capital helps. Faking a proof fails the audit and slashes a bonded stake, draining the nectar an attacker hoped to farm, while idle duplicates that skip audits decay to zero weight.
